description: This file defines the EmailConfigurationModel class within the OrangeHRM Admin API. The class implements serialization and normalization behavior for email configuration data, encapsulating an EmailConfiguration entity and exposing specific attributes related to email settings such as SMTP host, port, authentication, and security types.
